description: TGRS_HRRSD是一个用于高分辨率遥感图像目标检测的大型数据集，包含13种类别的遥感地物目标。图像提取自 Google Earth 和 百度地图，空间分辨率从 0.15米到1.2米 不等。
descriptionEn: A large-scale dataset for object detection in very high-resolution remote sensing imagery. It contains 13 categories of objects. The images are sourced from Google Earth and Baidu Map, with a spatial resolution ranging from 0.15m to 1.2m.

authorEn: Rodrigo Caye Daudt、Bertrand Le Saux、Alexandre Boulch、Yann Gousseau
licenseEn: This dataset is released under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike (CC BY-NC-SA) licence. The images are additionally released under IGN's "licence ouverte" (open license). The maps used to generate the labels come from the Copernicus program and are subject to its terms.
name: HRSCD
readme: HRSCD数据集包含291对经过配准的RGB航空影像对，源自法国国家地理与森林信息研究所（IGN）的BD ORTHO数据库。数据集提供了像素级的变化标注和土地利用/覆盖分类标注，这些标注是通过对Urban Atlas 2006、Urban Atlas 2012及Urban Atlas Change 2006-2012地图进行栅格化生成的。
alias: 高分辨率语义变化检测数据集
author: Rodrigo Caye Daudt、Bertrand Le Saux、Alexanadre Boulch、Yann Gousseau
license: 该数据集采用 Creative Commons BY-NC-SA（署名-非商业性使用-相同方式共享） 许可协议。影像部分同时受 IGN的“licence ouverte”（开放许可） 保护。标注所使用的地图来自 Copernicus计划，受其相关条款约束。
region: 法国，雷恩（Rennes）和卡昂（Caen）地区
description: 该数据集包含291对经过配准的RGB航空影像对，源自法国国家地理与森林信息研究所（IGN）的BD ORTHO数据库。数据集提供了像素级的变化标注和土地利用/覆盖分类标注，这些标注是通过对Urban Atlas 2006、Urban Atlas 2012及Urban Atlas Change 2006-2012地图进行栅格化生成的。
descriptionEn: This dataset contains 291 coregistered image pairs of RGB aerial images from IGS's BD ORTHO database. Pixel-level change and land cover annotations are provided, generated by rasterizing Urban Atlas 2006, Urban Atlas 2012, and Urban Atlas Change 2006-2012 maps.

authorEn: Zhenwei Shi et al. (Beihang University)
regionEn: The dataset covers various human living environments globally, including urban, rural, mountainous, and marine areas.
name: LEVIR
readme: LEVIR是一个大规模、高质量的遥感目标检测数据集。它由超过22,000张从Google Earth获取的高分辨率图像组成，图像大小为800×600像素，空间分辨率在0.2米到1.0米之间。数据集专注于3种目标类型：飞机 (Aircraft)、轮船 (Ship) 和油罐 (Storage Tank)。所有目标均以边界框 (Bounding Box) 形式进行了标注，总计超过11,000个独立标注框，其中包含4,724架飞机、3,025艘船和3,279个油罐。数据集旨在为遥感图像中的目标检测算法提供更具挑战性的训练和评估基准。
alias: LEVIR 遥感目标检测数据集
aliasEn: LEarning, VIsion and Remote sensing laboratory
author: 史振威
region: 图像覆盖全球多个地区的人类居住环境，包括城市、乡村、山区和海洋等。
description: LEVIR是一个大规模、高质量的遥感目标检测数据集。它由超过22,000张从Google Earth获取的高分辨率图像组成，图像大小为800×600像素，空间分辨率在0.2米到1.0米之间。数据集专注于3种目标类型：飞机 (Aircraft)、轮船 (Ship) 和油罐 (Storage Tank)。所有目标均以边界框 (Bounding Box) 形式进行了标注，总计超过11,000个独立标注框，其中包含4,724架飞机、3,025艘船和3,279个油罐。数据集旨在为遥感图像中的目标检测算法提供更具挑战性的训练和评估基准。
descriptionEn: The LEVIR dataset is a large-scale, high-quality dataset for remote sensing target detection. It consists of over 22,000 high-resolution images sourced from Google Earth, with a size of 800×600 pixels and a spatial resolution ranging from 0.2m to 1.0m. The dataset focuses on 3 categories of objects: aircraft, ship, and storage tank. All targets are annotated with bounding boxes, totaling more than 11,000 independent boxes, including 4,724 aircraft, 3,025 ships, and 3,279 storage tanks. It serves as a challenging benchmark for training and evaluating object detection algorithms in remote sensing imagery.

authorEn: German Aerospace Center (DLR)
name: DLR-MVDA
readme: 德国航空航天中心（DLR）发布的用于航空影像中多类别车辆检测和方向识别的公开数据集。图像拍摄于德国慕尼黑上空约1000米高度，覆盖面积约54.7平方公里。数据集旨在支持交通管理、停车监控和城市规划等研究。
alias: DLR 航空影像多类别车辆检测与方向数据集
aliasEn: DLR Multi-class Vehicle Detection and Orientation in Aerial Imagery (DLR-MVDA)
author: 德国航空航天中心 (DLR)
region: 德国，慕尼黑
description: 德国航空航天中心（DLR）发布的用于航空影像中多类别车辆检测和方向识别的公开数据集。图像拍摄于德国慕尼黑上空约1000米高度，覆盖面积约54.7平方公里。数据集旨在支持交通管理、停车监控和城市规划等研究。
descriptionEn: An open aerial image dataset with annotated vehicles released by the German Aerospace Center (DLR) to support research in traffic management, parking surveillance, and urban planning. The images were captured over Munich, Germany from a plane flying approximately 1000m above ground, covering an area of about 54.7 km².

authorEn: Shunjun Wei, Xiangfeng Zeng, Qizhe Qu, Mou Wang, Hao Su, Jun Shi
regionEn: Global. The images cover multiple ports and sea areas (including coastal regions of China, Europe, North America, etc.).
bandDescEn: Single-band grayscale images (SAR magnitude imagery). SAR images from different sources may contain various polarizations (e.g., HH, HV, VV, VH), but the dataset provides processed magnitude images (single-channel).
name: HRSID-v1
readme: HRSID 是一个用于SAR图像中船舶检测和实例分割的高分辨率基准数据集。它包含 5,604 张高分辨率SAR图像，共标注了 16,951 个船舶实例。图像来源于 Sentinel-1、RadarSat-2 和 TerraSAR-X 三颗卫星，覆盖全球多个港口和海域，空间分辨率在 0.5 米至 3 米之间。该数据集提供了边界框（检测）和像素级掩膜（实例分割）两种标注格式，旨在为基于深度学习的SAR图像目标检测与分割算法提供具有挑战性的训练与评估基准。
alias: HRSID 高分辨率SAR图像数据集（v1.0）
author: Shunjun Wei, Xiangfeng Zeng, Qizhe Qu, Mou Wang, Hao Su, Jun Shi
region: 全球范围，图像覆盖多个港口和海域（包括中国、欧洲、北美等沿海区域）
bandDesc: 单波段灰度图像（SAR幅度图像）。不同来源的SAR图像可能包含多种极化方式（如 HH、HV、VV、VH），但数据集中提供的是经处理后的幅度图像（单通道）。
description: HRSID 是一个用于SAR图像中船舶检测和实例分割的高分辨率基准数据集。它包含 5,604 张高分辨率SAR图像，共标注了 16,951 个船舶实例。图像来源于 Sentinel-1、RadarSat-2 和 TerraSAR-X 三颗卫星，覆盖全球多个港口和海域，空间分辨率在 0.5 米至 3 米之间。该数据集提供了边界框（检测）和像素级掩膜（实例分割）两种标注格式，旨在为基于深度学习的SAR图像目标检测与分割算法提供具有挑战性的训练与评估基准。
descriptionEn: HRSID is a high-resolution benchmark dataset for ship detection and instance segmentation in SAR imagery. It contains 5,604 high-resolution SAR images with 16,951 annotated ship instances. The images are sourced from three satellites—Sentinel-1, RadarSat-2, and TerraSAR-X—covering multiple ports and sea areas globally, with spatial resolutions ranging from 0.5 m to 3 m. The dataset provides both bounding box annotations (detection) and pixel-level masks (instance segmentation), serving as a challenging benchmark for training and evaluating deep learning-based object detection and segmentation algorithms in SAR imagery.

authorEn: Xian Sun, Peijin Wang, Zhiyuan Yan, Xue Yang, et al.
regionEn: Global. The images are primarily sourced from multiple countries and regions, including China, the United States, Europe, and the Middle East.
name: FAIR1M-v1
readme: FAIR1M 是一个面向航空遥感图像中细粒度目标检测的大规模基准数据集。它包含超过 15,000 张高分辨率光学遥感图像，标注了超过 100 万个目标实例，覆盖 37 个细粒度目标类别（分为飞机、船舶、车辆、场地和道路等超类）。图像采集自全球多个国家和地区，空间分辨率在 0.3 米至 2 米之间。该数据集采用旋转边界框（OBB） 标注，旨在为深度学习目标检测算法提供极具挑战性的训练与评估基准，尤其强调对目标细粒度子类别的区分能力。
alias: FAIR1M 细粒度航空图像识别数据集（v1.0）
author: Xian Sun, Peijin Wang, Zhiyuan Yan, Xue Yang, et al.
region: 全球范围，图像主要采集自中国、美国、欧洲、中东等多个国家和地区的遥感影像。
description: FAIR1M 是一个面向航空遥感图像中细粒度目标检测的大规模基准数据集。它包含超过 15,000 张高分辨率光学遥感图像，标注了超过 100 万个目标实例，覆盖 37 个细粒度目标类别（分为飞机、船舶、车辆、场地和道路等超类）。图像采集自全球多个国家和地区，空间分辨率在 0.3 米至 2 米之间。该数据集采用旋转边界框（OBB） 标注，旨在为深度学习目标检测算法提供极具挑战性的训练与评估基准，尤其强调对目标细粒度子类别的区分能力。
descriptionEn: FAIR1M is a large-scale benchmark dataset for fine-grained object detection in aerial remote sensing imagery. It contains over 15,000 high-resolution optical remote sensing images with more than 1 million annotated object instances, covering 37 fine-grained object categories (grouped into superclasses such as aircraft, ships, vehicles, playgrounds, and roads). The images are sourced from multiple countries and regions globally, with spatial resolutions ranging from 0.3 m to 2 m. The dataset uses oriented bounding boxes (OBB) for annotation, serving as a challenging benchmark for training and evaluating deep learning-based object detection algorithms, with a particular emphasis on distinguishing fine-grained subcategories.

authorEn: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS), Laboratory of Pattern Recognition and Intelligent System Development.
name: UCAS-AOD-v1
readme: UCAS-AOD一个用于航空影像中飞机和车辆检测的经典遥感目标检测数据集。由中国科学院大学于2014年发布，2015年补充完善。数据来自 Google Earth 卫星影像，标注了飞机和汽车两类目标。数据集包含大量背景负样本，以提升模型抗干扰能力。该数据集特别强调目标方向均匀性，支持旋转目标检测算法研究。
alias: UCAS-AOD 遥感目标检测数据集
aliasEn: UCAS-AOD (University of Chinese Academy of Sciences - Aerial Object Detection)
author: 中国科学院大学（UCAS）模式识别与智能系统开发实验室。
description: UCAS-AOD是一个用于航空影像中飞机和车辆检测的经典遥感目标检测数据集。由中国科学院大学于2014年发布，2015年补充完善。数据来自 Google Earth 卫星影像，标注了飞机和汽车两类目标。数据集包含大量背景负样本，以提升模型抗干扰能力。该数据集特别强调目标方向均匀性，支持旋转目标检测算法研究。
descriptionEn: A classic remote sensing object detection dataset for airplane and car detection in aerial images. Released by the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences in 2014 and supplemented in 2015. The images are sourced from Google Earth satellite imagery, with annotations for two object categories: airplane and car. The dataset also includes a significant number of background negative samples to improve model robustness. It emphasizes orientation uniformity of objects and supports rotated object detection research.

authorEn: Naval Aviation University; later maintained by Prof. Xiaoling Zhang's team at the University of Electronic Science and T
regionEn: Various sea areas globally, with data sourced from Chinese Gaofen-3, European Sentinel-1, etc.
bandDescEn: SAR imagery is typically single-channel grayscale; may include various polarizations.
name: SSDD-v1
readme: SSDD是一个SAR图像舰船检测开放数据集。数据来源包括RadarSat-2、TerraSAR-X、Sentinel-1等多颗卫星。包含1160张影像和2456艘船只，涵盖港口、近岸、岛屿、远海等多种场景，以及油轮、散货船、渔船等多种船舶类型。
alias: SAR舰船检测数据集
author: 海军航空航天大学；后续官方版本由电子科技大学张晓玲教授团队发布和维护
region: 全球多个海域，数据来源包括中国高分三号、欧洲哨兵一号等
bandDesc: SAR图像通常为单通道灰度图像，可能包含多种极化方式。
description: SSDD是一个SAR图像舰船检测开放数据集。数据来源包括RadarSat-2、TerraSAR-X、Sentinel-1等多颗卫星。包含1160张影像和2456艘船只，涵盖港口、近岸、岛屿、远海等多种场景，以及油轮、散货船、渔船等多种船舶类型。
descriptionEn: The first open dataset for ship detection in SAR imagery. It sources data from multiple satellites including RadarSat-2, TerraSAR-X, and Sentinel-1. It contains 1,160 images with 2,456 ship instances, covering various scenes such as ports, inshore areas, islands, and open seas, as well as diverse ship types like oil tankers, bulk carriers, and fishing vessels.

authorEn: AISKYEYE team at the Lab of Machine Learning and Data Mining, Tianjin University
regionEn: 14 different cities across China, covering urban and rural environments.
name: VisDrone2019-DET-v1
readme: VisDrone2019-DET是一个大规模无人机航拍图像目标检测基准数据集。其检测子集 (VisDrone2019-DET) 包含 8,629 张图像，标注了 10 个目标类别。该数据集由天津大学机器学习与数据挖掘实验室的 AISKYEYE 团队创建。完整的 VisDrone 基准测试包含 288 个视频片段（共 261,908 帧）和 10,209 张静态图像。
alias: VisDrone2019-DET 无人机航拍目标检测数据集
aliasEn: VisDrone2019-DET (Vision Meets Drone Object Detection in Image Challenge 2019)
author: AISKYEYE 团队（天津大学机器学习与数据挖掘实验室）
region: 中国14个不同城市，涵盖城市和乡村环境。
description: VisDrone2019-DET是一个大规模无人机航拍图像目标检测基准数据集。其检测子集 (VisDrone2019-DET) 包含 8,629 张图像，标注了 10 个目标类别。该数据集由天津大学机器学习与数据挖掘实验室的 AISKYEYE 团队创建。完整的 VisDrone 基准测试包含 288 个视频片段（共 261,908 帧）和 10,209 张静态图像。
descriptionEn: A large-scale drone-based image benchmark for object detection. Its detection subset (VisDrone2019-DET) provides 8,629 annotated aerial images with 10 object classes. It was created by the AISKYEYE team at Tianjin University. The full VisDrone benchmark consists of 288 video clips (261,908 frames) and 10,209 static images.

authorEn: University of Caen; Paper authors: Razakarivony, S. and Jurie, F.
bandDescEn: Provides both Red, Green, Blue (RGB) three-band color imagery and infrared (IR) imagery. Images are available in several spectral bands and resolutions.
name: VEDAI-v1
readme: VEDAI是一个用于航拍图像中车辆目标检测的基准数据集。图像来源于美国犹他州的遥感影像，包含多种光谱波段和分辨率。数据集中的车辆目标具有多方向、光照/阴影变化、镜面反射和遮挡等多样性。数据同时提供RGB和红外（IR） 两种模态，并采用有向边界框（OBB） 标注格式。
alias: VEDAI 航拍车辆检测数据集
author: 卡昂大学（University of Caen）；相关论文作者为 Razakarivony, S. 和 Jurie, F.
region: 美国犹他州（Utah）
bandDesc: 提供红、绿、蓝（RGB） 三通道彩色图像和红外（IR） 图像两种模态。图像可在多种光谱波段和分辨率下获取。
description: VEDAI是一个用于航拍图像中车辆目标检测的基准数据集。图像来源于美国犹他州的遥感影像，包含多种光谱波段和分辨率。数据集中的车辆目标具有多方向、光照/阴影变化、镜面反射和遮挡等多样性。数据同时提供RGB和红外（IR） 两种模态，并采用有向边界框（OBB） 标注格式。
descriptionEn: VEDAI is a benchmark dataset for vehicle detection in aerial imagery. The images are sourced from Utah's remote sensing imagery and are available in several spectral bands and resolutions. The vehicles in the dataset exhibit multiple orientations, lighting/shadowing changes, specularities, and occlusions. The dataset provides both RGB and infrared (IR) modalities and uses oriented bounding boxes (OBB) for annotation.

authorEn: Gerhard Heitz和Daphne Koller (斯坦福大学)
name: TAS-v1
readme: TAS是一个经典的航空影像车辆检测数据集。包含 30张 从Google Earth提取的航拍图像，共标注了 1,319辆 汽车。图像的空间分辨率相对较低，受建筑物和树木造成的阴影影响较多。
alias: TAS 数据集
author: Gerhard Heitz和Daphne Koller (斯坦福大学)
description: TAS数据集是一个经典的航空影像车辆检测数据集。包含 30张 从Google Earth提取的航拍图像，共标注了 1,319辆 汽车。图像的空间分辨率相对较低，受建筑物和树木造成的阴影影响较多。
descriptionEn: classic aerial image dataset for vehicle (car) detection. It contains 30 images extracted from Google Earth, with a total of 1,319 manually annotated cars. The spatial resolution is relatively low, with significant shadows caused by buildings and trees.

authorEn: Kartik Bhartiya
name: SwimmingPoolCarDet
readme: Swimming Pool and Car Detection数据集用于在卫星图像中检测游泳池和汽车。数据集包含3,748张用于训练的224x224像素JPG图像，以及对应的XML标签文件，记录了图像中游泳池和汽车的边界框（Bounding Box）信息。测试集包含2,703张图片，但无标签。
alias: 游泳池和汽车检测数据集
aliasEn: Swimming Pool and Car Detection Dataset
author: Kartik Bhartiya
description: 该数据集用于在卫星图像中检测游泳池和汽车。数据集包含3,748张用于训练的224x224像素JPG图像，以及对应的XML标签文件，记录了图像中游泳池和汽车的边界框（Bounding Box）信息。
descriptionEn: This dataset is used to detect swimming pools and cars in satellite images. The training set contains 3,748 JPG images of 224x224 pixels, each with a corresponding XML file that records the bounding box information for swimming pools and cars.

authorEn: Wuhan University
regionEn: The images are primarily sourced from global commercial satellite imagery such as Google Earth and Bing Maps, covering various regions worldwide.
name: RSOD-v1
readme: RSOD是一个开放的遥感影像目标检测数据集，主要用于航空与卫星影像中典型人造地物的识别与检测。数据集共包含936张高分辨率遥感图像，标注了四类目标：飞机 (aircraft)、油罐 (oiltank)、立交桥 (overpass) 和运动场 (playground)。图像主要来源于Google Earth、Bing Maps等商业卫星影像，空间分辨率普遍在0.3至1.0米之间。所有图像均经过人工精细标注，并同时提供PASCAL VOC格式（XML） 和YOLO格式（TXT） 两种标注体系，适配多种主流目标检测模型。
alias: 遥感目标检测数据集
author: 武汉大学相关团队
region: 图像主要来源于Google Earth、Bing Maps等全球商业卫星影像，覆盖多个国家和地区。
description: RSOD是一个开放的遥感影像目标检测数据集，主要用于航空与卫星影像中典型人造地物的识别与检测。数据集共包含936张高分辨率遥感图像，标注了四类目标：飞机 (aircraft)、油罐 (oiltank)、立交桥 (overpass) 和运动场 (playground)。图像主要来源于Google Earth、Bing Maps等商业卫星影像，空间分辨率普遍在0.3至1.0米之间。所有图像均经过人工精细标注，并同时提供PASCAL VOC格式（XML） 和YOLO格式（TXT） 两种标注体系，适配多种主流目标检测模型。
descriptionEn: RSOD is an open dataset for object detection in remote sensing images. It contains a total of 936 high-quality remote sensing images, with annotations for four categories of objects: aircraft, oiltank, overpass, and playground. The images are primarily sourced from commercial satellite imagery such as Google Earth and Bing Maps, with a spatial resolution generally ranging from 0.3 to 1.0 meters. All images are manually annotated with high precision and are provided in both PASCAL VOC format (XML) and YOLO format (TXT) , making it compatible with a wide range of object detection models.

authorEn: T. Nathan Mundhenk, Goran Konjevod, Wesam A. Sakla, Kofi Boakye
regionEn: Multiple regions globally, primarily including the United States, Germany, the Middle East, Spain, and other areas.
name: COWC-v1

descriptionEn: SYSU-CD is an open aerial image dataset for remote sensing change detection. The dataset covers various types of changes, including new urban buildings, suburban expansion, groundwork before construction, vegetation changes, road expansion, and marine development. It serves as a benchmark for training and evaluating deep learning models.

descriptionEn: ITCVD dataset is a large-scale, well annotated and challenging vehicle detection dataset.The images were taken from an airplane platform which flied over Enschede, The Netherlands, in the height of ca $330$m above the ground.The images are taken in both nadir view and oblique view.The tilt angle of oblique view is 45 degrees.The Ground Sampling Distance of the nadir images is 10cm.In total, 173 images are selected among which 135 images with 23543 vehicles are used for training and the remaining 38 images with 5545 vehicles for testing.Each vehicle in the dataset is manually annotated using a bounding box.

descriptionEn: The NWPU VHR-10 dataset is a challenging ten-class geospatial object detection dataset. The dataset is divided into a positive image set (650 images containing at least one target) and a negative image set (150 images without any targets). All objects were manually annotated with bounding boxes and instance masks.

The aerial imagery subset covers approximately 450km² over Christchurch, New Zealand, containing about 220,000 independent buildings. name: LJ4I_HSI_32B
alias: 人民健康号高光谱数据（32波段）
description:
人民健康号（珞珈四号01星）由武汉大学宇航科学与技术研究院总体设计，联合哈尔滨工大卫星技术有限公司、中国科学院长春光学精密机械与物理研究所等单位研制，旨在通过“遥感+医学”融合创新，建立面向环境健康因素的广域综合监测系统，实现对影响人类健康的“水-土-气”等环境因子的高精度遥感智能反演，填补全球健康研究领域遥感监测空白。
2024年9月24日10时31分，人民健康号搭乘捷龙三号固体运载火箭，在山东海阳东方航天港点火升空，顺利进入预定轨道。该卫星具备多种先进功能，涵盖可见光高光谱成像、紫外多光谱成像等多种任务模式，拥有在轨数据采集与处理能力，业务化运行基础扎实，数传速率达每秒900M。
人民健康号卫星可获取多种模式的高光谱影像，涵盖5谱、9谱、17谱、32谱等，本数据为32谱。数据经过系统的辐射校正处理，产品级别为L1A；对应的单幅成像幅宽可达300km，单幅图幅面积可达120万km²，能高效满足大范围环境健康因子普查与精准监测的需求。

name: CN_FCH30_2020
alias: 2020年中国30m冠层高度产品
description: 本产品融合了2019-2023年NASA GEDI星载激光雷达离散光斑采样数据，以及2020年的Sentinel-1/2多源卫星遥感影像数据； 通过对GEDI进行地形校正得到坡度不敏感的GEDI-SAWA参考高度数据，同时依据植被分区构建物候一致的有叶季影像合成特征，基于U-Net深度学习模型，制作中国10m分辨率的冠层高度图，最终经过均值聚合，生成最终2020年30m分辨率冠层高度产品。
descriptionEn: This product integrates the discrete light spot sampling data of NASA GEDI airborne laser radar from 2019 to 2023, as well as the multi-source satellite remote sensing image data of Sentinel-1/2 in 2020. By performing terrain correction on GEDI, slope-insensitive GEDI-SAWA reference height data is obtained. At the same time, based on the vegetation zoning, consistent phenological images of the leaf season are synthesized for features. Using the U-Net deep learning model, a 10-meter resolution canopy height map of China is produced. Finally, through mean aggregation, the final 30-meter resolution canopy height product for 2020 is generated.

description: 是基于 Landsat 系列卫星影像数据（包括 Landsat-5 TM、Landsat-7 ETM+ 和 Landsat-8 OLI 等），在 HiGLASS 框架下经过大气校正、几何精校正及质量控制后生成的 30 米地表反射率产品。该产品反映了地表真实的光谱特征，消除了大气影响，适用于长时间序列的陆地生态环境监测、土地利用/覆盖变化研究、农业监测以及碳循环评估等高精度遥感应用。
descriptionEn: HiGLASS_SR_Landsat_30m is a 30-meter surface reflectance product generated from Landsat series satellite imagery (including Landsat-5 TM, Landsat-7 ETM+, and Landsat-8 OLI) within the HiGLASS framework.
